basic_details.job_title: ICDS Darbha Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for Anganwadi Worker, Anganwadi Helper Posts
basic_details.total_vacancies: Anganwadi Worker (Anganwadi Karyakarta), Anganwadi Helper (Anganwadi Sahayika)
basic_details.job_location: Anganwadi Centre Kondlur Handapara; Anganwadi Centre Chhindawara No. 11 (Darbha project)
basic_details.short_information: Online applications are open until 2 December 2026 for Anganwadi Worker and Anganwadi Helper posts under Integrated Child Development Project (Ekikrit Bal Vikas Pariyojana) Darbha, Jagdalpur. The Anganwadi Worker and Helper posts are at Anganwadi Centre Kondlur Handapara, and an Anganwadi Helper post is at Anganwadi Centre Chhindawara No. 11. Applications are made on the e-Bharti link aww.e-bharti.in.

how_to_apply: Go to the e-Bharti online link, https://aww.e-bharti.in/, given in the notice.
Submit the online application form there by 2 December 2026.

For details of the recruitment, see the detailed advertisement on the notice boards of Janpad Panchayat Office Darbha, Integrated Child Development Office Darbha, and the Gram Panchayat offices of Karka and Peramaras.

content_sections.heading: About Darbha Anganwadi Recruitment
content_sections.text: The posts are vacant Anganwadi positions in Anganwadi centres under Integrated Child Development Project Darbha. The notice was issued from Jagdalpur on 17 November 2026 through the Chhattisgarh public relations department's news page.

content_sections.heading: Darbha Anganwadi Recruitment 2026 Important Dates
content_sections.text: The notice prints one deadline only, for the online application on the e-Bharti link.

content_sections.heading: Vacancies by Project / Block
content_sections.text: The posts are in Integrated Child Development Project Darbha. The notice names the centres and posts but prints no number of vacancies. Kondlur Handapara has both posts, and Chhindawara No. 11 has the Helper post only.
